notes.title: CINESCAPE VR will be present at Gamescom 2025 !
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45659016/ff7e5044067e1a1c8ef49c3968017d73c057fadd.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]SUPER AC is proud to announce its presence at Gamescom in Cologne, Germany, this year, from August 20th to 24th, Hall 10.1, Booth B.091. [/h2][p][/p][p]At our booth, visitors will be able to try out: [/p][list][*][p][b]PROHIBEAST[/b], [/p][/*][*][p][b]EONA[/b], [/p][/*][*][p][b]CINESCAPE VR[/b], [/p][/*][*][p]and [b]SKY LEGENDS, an aeropostal epic[/b]. [/p][/*][/list][p]Come to meet the development teams and have a great time with us. [/p][p]We look forward seeing you there.[/p][p][/p][p][i]PS: Free goodies for everyone who finishes the demo![/i] [/p][p][b][i]THE SUPER AC TEAM[/i][/b][/p]
